server.instructions: Crow Memory — Inkumbulo yangaphandle ye-sinapse yee-arhente ze-AI ezibhala ikhowudi. Igcina isimbo sakho sokubhala ikhowudi, ukuqonda kwakho iimpazamo, kunye nezinto ozithandayo ze-akhithektjha njengeematriki zobunzima ezicuthiweyo kwi-crow.bin.

crow_memory_bias.description: Ibhloko ye-bias ye-Crow Memory efakwa ngokuzenzekelayo. Iqulethe isimbo sakho sokubhala ikhowudi, izinto ozithandayo, nemithetho ephuhliselweyo. Umamkeli (host) kufuneka ayilayishe ekuqaleni kweseshoni.

crow_evolved_rules.description: Permanent evolved rules from Crow's system_prompt.md: permanent rules (human-promoted via CROW_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus unreviewed model suggestions.

crow_recall.description: Khumbula isimbo sokubhala ikhowudi esihambelana nomsebenzisi, ukuqonda iimpazamo, izinto azithandayo ze-akhithektjha, okanye umxholo wobuqu kwiinkumbulo ze-sinapse ze-Crow. Biza oku NGAPHAMBI kwayo yonke impendulo ukuze uhambelane ne-inductive bias yomsebenzisi. Ngokuzenzekelayo (register=all okanye ishiyiwe, domain=all), ibuza zonke ii-register ezisi-8 kwaye idibanisa iziphumo kwihlabathi lonke ngokufana okusebenzayo.

parameters.register: Yeyiphi i-register. Sebenzisa 'all' (okanye uyeke) ukubuza zonke ii-register kwidomeyini ekhethiweyo. Code: style/bug/arch/context. Life: life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context.
parameters.domain: Isihluzo sedomeyini esisetyenziswa xa i-register iyi-'all' okanye ishiyiwe. 'code' = style/bug/arch/context, 'life' = life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context, 'all' = zonke ii-register ezisi-8 (okungagqibekanga).
parameters.format: Ifomathi yemveliso. 'hint' ibuyisela iingcebiso ze-JSON (okungagqibekanga); 'bias_block' ibuyisela ibhloko yombhalo [User Bias] yokufakwa kwi-system prompt.
parameters.project: Ithegi yeprojekthi esetyenziselwa ukunyusa iingcebiso zeprojekthi efanayo nokuhluzwa nokohlwaywa kwezo zivela kwenye iprojekthi.
parameters.strict_project: Xa iyinyaniso (true), ikhupha ngokupheleleyo iingcebiso zeprojekthi ezahlukileyo kwiziphumo.

crow_ingest.description: Faka amava okubhala ikhowudi kwiinkumbulo ze-sinapse zexesha elide ze-Crow. Biza EMVA kweziphumo zokwakha okanye zovavanyo, okanye emva kwempendulo ecacileyo yomsebenzisi. Nika i-polarity ecacileyo okanye i-exit_code yokwakha ukuze i-polarity ihlelwe ngokuzenzekelayo. Umxholo uhlanjululwa kuqala; igalelo eliyimpempe liyaliwa ngaphandle kokuchukumisa inkumbulo.

parameters.polarity: Amandla okuqinisa [-2.0, 2.0]. Ayinyanzelekanga ukuba i-exit_code inikiwe; i-polarity ecacileyo iyaphumelela xa zombini zinikiwe.
parameters.exit_code: Ikhowudi yokuphuma yokwakha (0 = impumelelo). Ihlelwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwi-polarity (+1.5/+0.5 xa kuphumelele, -0.5/-1.0 xa kusilele) ngaphandle kokuba i-polarity ecacileyo inikiwe.
parameters.user_edited: Ukuba umsebenzisi wayihlela imveliso ye-AI. Ilungisa i-polarity evela kwi-exit_code.
parameters.project: Ithegi yeprojekthi egcinwa kunye nongeno lwenkumbulo ukuze kamva kukhunjulwe ngokuqonda iprojekthi.

crow_admin.description: Imisebenzi yokulawula ye-Crow kwisixhobo esinye. Izenzo: diagnostics (izibalo zeenkumbulo), drift (ukujonga i-drift), prompt (ukufunda/ukongeza/izibalo ze-system_prompt.md), backup (ukudala/ukujikeleza/ukudwelisa/ukubuyisela), evolve (ukuphakamisa iinguqu ze-prompt), project_info (ukudwelisa/ukudala iimeko zeprojekthi).

parameters.action: Yeyiphi imisebenzi yokulawula: diagnostics, drift, prompt, backup, evolve, okanye project_info.
parameters.args: Into yeeargumenti zezenzo ezithunyelwa kumsebenzi okhethiweyo.

recall_messages.faint_bias: I-Crow ikhumbula i-bias ye-{register} encinci. Zimbalwa iinkumbulo ezigciniweyo okwangoku.

evolve_messages.no_patterns: Akukho patheni zibalulekileyo ngokwezibalo ezibonweyo okwangoku.

drift_messages.confused: Inkumbulo ye-Crow ibonakala ididekile. Imisebenzi yamvanje isenokuba mitsha kakhulu okanye inkumbulo igcwele. Cinga nge-spectral reset okanye ngokufaka kwi-akhivi.

system_prompt.subtitle:
> Le mithetho yaphuhliswa yi-Crow yaza yamkelwa ngumsebenzisi.
> Imele i-bias zokubhala ikhowudi ezibalulekileyo ngokwezibalo.
> Musa ukuyihlela ngesandla — sebenzisa izixhobo ze-evolve ze-Crow MCP.
default_rules: RULE: Phambi kwayo yonke impendulo, biza i-crow_recall(domain="all") ukubuza zonke ii-register ezisi-8 (style, bug, arch, context, life_pref, life_avoid, life_phil, life_context) ngesimbo somsebenzisi sokubhala ikhowudi, ukuqonda iimpazamo, izinto azithandayo ze-akhithektjha, ukuthanda kwakhe, ifilosofi, nomxholo wangoku. Bonisa iingcebiso ezibuyisiweyo kwimpendulo yakho.

RULE: Emva kwayo yonke impendulo, faka oko umsebenzisi akutyhilileyo — izinto azithandayo, ifilosofi, izilungiso, umxholo — nge-crow_ingest. Gweba wena i-register ne-polarity efanelekileyo ngaphandle kokulinda ukuba umsebenzisi athi "khumbula oku." Emva komsebenzi wekhowudi, vavanya ngokuzenzekelayo iziphumo zokwakha nge-crow_ingest_from_build.
RULE: Musa ukutsiba imithetho ye-recall+ingest nkqu kwimisebenzi engeyiyo eyekhowudi njengokuhlela amaxwebhu, imisebenzi ye-git, okanye iinguqu zokumisela. Zihlale uzifezekisa.
